Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread IMDb’s listed Denmark release year for Gaza Ghetto as 1998 instead of 1988 and then concluded Gaza Ghetto (1998) was more recent than Kull the Conqueror (1997). This was a data extraction/reading error from the IMDb release info, compounded by using the latest regional release rather than the initial widely recognized release year; either way, the incorrect 1998 reading led to a wrong conclusion.
